files.content:
<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/storefront.ts -->
<!--
  The hero of a store: a badge, the heading, a lead, one or two actions and three store promises. The overlay
  layout puts a picture beside the text with an offer card floating on it; the backdrop layout puts the text
  over a faint picture. Axes: layout (overlay, backdrop), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { OfferCard } from "./store-hero.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type StoreHeroProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    actions: LinkActions;
    perks: Feature[];
    card: OfferCard;
    layout?: "overlay" | "backdrop";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.svelte";
  import OfferMedia from "../components/offer-media.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    level = 1,
    actions,
    perks,
    card,
    layout = "overlay",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StoreHeroProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "backdrop")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge, level }}
    tone={tone}
    density="roomy"
    measure="3xl"
    class={(("image" === "image") ? "relative isolate overflow-hidden" : "")}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <Backdrop kind="image" alt={title} />
    <ActionGroup
      primary={actions.cta}
      primaryHref={actions.href}
      secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
      secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    />
    <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="perks">
      {#each perks as p, i (p.id)}
        {#if (i < 3)}
          <Group gap="4" align="start" data-testid="perk">
            <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
              <LucideIcon name={p.icon} size={20} />
            </Box>
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {p.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {p.text}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge, level }}
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
    tone={tone}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <ActionGroup
      primary={actions.cta}
      primaryHref={actions.href}
      secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
      secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    />
    <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="perks">
      {#each perks as p, i (p.id)}
        {#if (i < 3)}
          <Group gap="4" align="start" data-testid="perk">
            <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
              <LucideIcon name={p.icon} size={20} />
            </Box>
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {p.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {p.text}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Grid>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <OfferMedia alt={title} card={card} />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
